Aggressive Ray Marching with SDF is a rendering technique that uses Signed Distance Field (SDF) values to dynamically determine step sizes along camera rays, allowing for large skips in empty space and fine-grained sampling near surfaces [S1, unofficial].

The code snippet further confirms this by showing the update rule `marching_zdepth` by adding the product of the clamped SDF and `self.ray_marching_ratio`, which directly implements the dynamic step sizing based on SDF values described in the claim.
